tasks.title: Hashing and verifying a password
tasks.statement:
Write the functions hash_password(&str) -> String (default Argon2, the result is a PHC string) and verify_password(&str, &str) -> bool (password, hash). Print: the hash starts with «$argon2id$», the correct password passes, a wrong one does not, and two hashes of the same password computed twice differ (the salt).

Expected output:
true
true
false
true
tasks.hint: Argon2::default().hash_password(pw.as_bytes()).unwrap().to_string(); verify_password(pw.as_bytes(), hash_str).is_ok(); you need the PasswordHasher and PasswordVerifier traits.

tasks.title: Fix: the PasswordVerifier trait is missing
tasks.statement:
The code does not compile: the verify_password method belongs to a trait that is not imported. Fix the imports so that the program prints «верно: true» and «неверно: false».

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«верно: true»
«неверно: false»
tasks.hint: use argon2::password_hash::{PasswordHasher, PasswordVerifier};

tasks.title: Password rules
tasks.statement:
Write validate_password(pw, username) -> Vec<&'static str> returning the list of violations in the order of checking: «короткий» (shorter than 8 characters), «нет цифры», «нет буквы», «совпадает с именем» (case-insensitive). An empty list means the password is acceptable. Count characters with chars().

Expected output:
"secret123": []
"short1": ["короткий"]
"onlyletters": ["нет цифры"]
"12345678": ["нет буквы"]
"Anna2026!": ["совпадает с именем"]
"пароль-123": []
"": ["короткий", "нет цифры", "нет буквы"]
tasks.hint: chars().count(), chars().any(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()), c.is_alphabetic(), eq_ignore_ascii_case / to_lowercase.

tasks.title: Constant-time comparison
tasks.statement:
Write tokens_equal(a: &str, b: &str) -> bool that compares secrets in time that does not depend on the position of the first difference: use subtle::ConstantTimeEq (strings of different length give false). Print the results for the pairs, including empty strings.

Expected output:
"abc" "abc" true
"abc" "abd" false
"abc" "abcd" false
"" "" true
"x" "" false
tasks.hint: use subtle::ConstantTimeEq; bool::from(a.as_bytes().ct_eq(b.as_bytes())).

tasks.title: Random session token
tasks.statement:
Write new_token() -> String: 32 random bytes (rand::random::<[u8; 32]>()) written as lowercase hexadecimal digits (hex::encode). Print the token length, whether all characters are lowercase hex digits, and that a thousand tokens are all distinct.

Expected output:
64
true
1000
tasks.hint: let b: [u8; 32] = rand::random(); hex::encode(b).

tasks.title: Token hash
tasks.statement:
Write token_hash(&str) -> String: the SHA-256 of the token as 64 lowercase hex characters. Check it on known values: the hash of the empty string and the hash of «abc», and also that the hash of one token is stable and differs between different tokens.

Expected output:
e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855
ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad
true
true
tasks.hint: use sha2::{Digest, Sha256}; hex::encode(Sha256::digest(token.as_bytes())).

tasks.title: Base64 for tokens
tasks.statement:
Write encode(&[u8]) -> String (URL-safe base64 without padding) and decode(&str) -> Option<Vec<u8>>. Check it on the bytes [0xfb, 0xff, 0xfe] (the result uses «-» and «_»), on an empty array, and that the invalid string «a$b» does not decode.

Expected output:
-__-
Some([251, 255, 254])
""
None
0L_RgNC40LLQtdGC
tasks.hint: use base64::{engine::general_purpose::URL_SAFE_NO_PAD, Engine}; URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(..), .decode(..).ok().

tasks.title: Signed token
tasks.statement:
Write sign(key: &[u8], user: u64, exp: u64) -> String of the form «user.exp.signature», where the signature is HMAC-SHA256 of the string «user.exp» in base64url without padding. And verify(key, token, now: u64) -> Result<u64, &'static str>: «формат» (format) if there are not three parts or the numbers do not parse; «подпись» (signature) if the signature is wrong (use mac.verify_slice, a constant-time comparison); «срок» (expiry) if exp <= now. Success is Ok(user). The error strings must be exactly the Russian words in «».

Expected output:
3
Ok(42)
Err("срок")
Err("подпись")
Err("подпись")
Err("формат")
Err("формат")
tasks.hint: Hmac::<Sha256>::new_from_slice(key) (needs the KeyInit trait); mac.update(payload.as_bytes()); finalize().into_bytes(); verify_slice.

tasks.title: Parsing the Authorization header
tasks.statement:
Write parse_bearer(header: Option<&str>) -> Option<&str>: it returns the token for «Bearer <token>» (scheme case-insensitive, exactly one space as the separator, the token non-empty and without spaces); in all other cases None. Check it on a set of headers.

Expected output:
Some("Bearer abc123") -> Some("abc123")
Some("bearer abc123") -> Some("abc123")
Some("BEARER x") -> Some("x")
Some("Basic abc") -> None
Some("Bearer") -> None
Some("Bearer ") -> None
Some("Bearer a b") -> None
Some("Bearerabc") -> None
Some("") -> None
None -> None
tasks.hint: split_once(' ') and eq_ignore_ascii_case("bearer").

tasks.title: Limiting login attempts
tasks.statement:
Implement Limiter { max: usize, window_ms: u64 } with the method attempt(&mut self, name: &str, now_ms: u64) -> Result<(), u64>. For each name keep a list of the moments of recent attempts. An attempt is allowed (Ok) if there are fewer than max of them in the last window_ms (counting only moments strictly after now − window_ms); then the moment is recorded. Otherwise it is Err(the number of milliseconds until the oldest window frees up): oldest + window_ms − now. Refusals are not recorded. Names are independent.

Expected output:
anna 0: Ok(())
anna 100: Ok(())
anna 200: Ok(())
anna 300: Err(700)
boris 300: Ok(())
anna 999: Err(1)
anna 1000: Ok(())
anna 1100: Ok(())
anna 1150: Err(50)
anna 1200: Ok(())
anna 2200: Ok(())
tasks.hint: HashMap<String, Vec<u64>>; retain(|&t| t + window > now); oldest = v[0].

tasks.title: Session cookies
tasks.hint: split(';'), trim, split_once('='); entry().or_insert.

tasks.title: CSRF protection: a paired token
tasks.statement:
Write csrf_ok(cookie: Option<&str>, header: Option<&str>) -> bool: the check passes only if both values are present, non-empty and equal (constant-time comparison, subtle). Check a set of cases.

Expected output:
Some("t1") Some("t1") true
Some("t1") Some("t2") false
None Some("t1") false
Some("t1") None false
None None false
Some("") Some("") false
Some("abc") Some("abcd") false
tasks.hint: match (cookie, header) { (Some(a), Some(b)) if !a.is_empty() && ... }

tasks.title: Decoding a signed JWT-like token
tasks.statement:
The function make_token(key, sub, exp) -> String already exists (header.payload.signature, the signature is HMAC-SHA256 of «header.payload», all parts are base64url without padding, the payload is JSON {"sub":..,"exp":..}). Write decode_claims(key, token, now) -> Result<(String, u64), &'static str>: «формат» (format) if there are not three parts, the base64 or JSON does not parse, or fields are missing; «подпись» (signature) if the signature is wrong (verify_slice); «срок» (expiry) if exp <= now. Success is (sub, exp). The error strings must be exactly the Russian words in «».

Expected output:
Ok(("anna", 500))
Err("срок")
Err("подпись")
Err("формат")
Err("формат")
Err("подпись")
tasks.hint: Verify the signature before parsing the payload as JSON; read the fields through serde_json::Value.

tasks.title: Time to rehash?
tasks.statement:
Write needs_rehash(phc: &str, target_m_cost: u32) -> bool: from the PHC string extract the parameter m (memory in KiB), which is the start of the fourth segment after «$» (…$m=19456,t=2,p=1$…), and return true if m is less than target or the string could not be parsed. Check it on a hash produced by default Argon2 (m = 19456) and on several strings.

Expected output:
false true
false
true
true
true
tasks.hint: phc.split('$').nth(3) → "m=19456,t=2,p=1"; split(',').find_map(|p| p.strip_prefix("m=")).

tasks.title: Dummy check for an unknown name
tasks.statement:
Write check_login(stored: Option<&str>, password: &str, calls: &AtomicUsize) -> bool. For a known user, check the password against the stored hash. For an unknown one (None) also run a check, against a prepared dummy hash DUMMY (you need a function dummy_hash() through OnceLock: the hash is computed once), and return false. Every Argon2 verification increments calls. After three attempts (known and correct, known and wrong, unknown) the counter must be 3. The last line is printed in Russian, exactly as shown.

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«true»
«false»
«false»
«проверок: 3»
tasks.hint: static DUMMY: OnceLock<String>; calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst) before every check.

tasks.title: Registration: the handler
tasks.statement:
POST /register accepts JSON {"name":..,"password":..}. Rules: the name is 3–16 characters, the password at least 8, otherwise 422 and the text «данные не годятся». On success: the password is hashed (hash_pw), the row is inserted, and the response is 201 and «ок». A repeated name (a UNIQUE violation, code 23505) gives 409 and «имя занято». The starter contains an empty app(pool); main prints the results and checks the stored hash. The response texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«201 ок»
«409 имя занято»
«422 данные не годятся»
«422 данные не годятся»
«true true false»
«пользователей: 1»
tasks.hint: Json<NewUser>; INSERT ... and parse e.as_database_error().and_then(|d| d.code()) == Some("23505"); State<PgPool>.

tasks.title: Login and issuing a token
tasks.statement:
POST /login accepts {"name":..,"password":..}. On success: a token is created (new_token()), token_hash(token) and an expiry of 24 hours are written to the sessions table, and the response is 200 with the token itself. An unknown name and a wrong password give the SAME response: 401 and «неверное имя или пароль». main registers anna / secret123 beforehand and prints the statuses, whether the error texts match, the token length, and that the database holds not the token itself but its hash. The texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«200 401 401»
«тексты ошибок совпадают: true»
«неверное имя или пароль»
«длина токена: 64»
«хранится хеш: true»
tasks.hint: SELECT id, pass_hash FROM users WHERE name = $1 (fetch_optional); check_pw; INSERT INTO sessions ... now() + interval '24 hours'.

tasks.title: Creating and looking up a session
tasks.statement:
Write create_session(&PgPool, user_id: i64) -> String (creates a token, writes the hash and an expiry of 1 hour, returns the token) and find_user(&PgPool, &str) -> Option<i64> (finds the user id by token through the hash). main creates two users and a session for the second; it prints Some(2) for the correct token, None for a random one and None for an empty one.

Expected output:
Some(2)
None
None
true
tasks.hint: sessions.token_hash is the hash; SELECT user_id FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $1.

tasks.title: Fix: expired sessions
tasks.statement:
Right now find_user also finds expired sessions. Fix the query so that only rows with expires_at in the future are considered. main creates a session for an hour and an already expired one (expiry −1 second) and prints the lookup results: Some(1) and None.

Expected output:
Some(1)
None
tasks.hint: AND expires_at > now().

tasks.title: The CurrentUser extractor
tasks.statement:
Implement the trait FromRequestParts<S> (where PgPool: FromRef<S>) for the struct CurrentUser { id, name, role, token_hash }: take the token from the Authorization header (the function bearer(&HeaderMap) -> Option<String> already exists), find a live session together with the user (JOIN sessions and users, expires_at > now()), otherwise return a rejection (StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED, «нужен вход»). The handler GET /me responds «вы: NAME (ROLE)». Check: a correct token, a missing header, a wrong token, a wrong scheme. Note that the expected output contains the texts «нужен токен» and «сессия недействительна», which must be produced for the missing header and the wrong token. The texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output:
(200, "вы: vera (admin)")
(401, "нужен токен")
(401, "сессия недействительна")
401 Unauthorized
tasks.hint: type Rejection = (StatusCode, &'static str); async fn from_request_parts(parts: &mut Parts, state: &S) -> Result<Self, Self::Rejection>; PgPool::from_ref(state).

tasks.title: Logging out
tasks.statement:
The CurrentUser extractor and the bearer and token-hash functions are already prepared. Write the handler POST /logout: it deletes the session of the current token (DELETE FROM sessions WHERE token_hash = $1 — the hash comes from CurrentUser) and responds 204. Check: /me with the token gives 200, after logout 401, a repeated logout 401, and the user's second session keeps working.

Expected output:
200
204
401
401
200
tasks.hint: The parameter user: CurrentUser; user.token_hash.

tasks.title: Logging out everywhere
tasks.statement:
Write logout_all(&PgPool, user_id: i64) -> u64, which deletes all of a user's sessions and returns their number. main creates three sessions for user 1 and one for user 2; print the number deleted and how many sessions each user has left. The labels are printed in Russian, exactly as shown.

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«удалено: 3»
«у пользователя 1: 0»
«у пользователя 2: 1»
«повторно: 0»
tasks.hint: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = $1; rows_affected().

tasks.title: No more than three sessions
tasks.statement:
Write create_limited(&PgPool, user_id, max: i64) -> String: it creates a session (token, hash, expiry one hour) and immediately deletes the oldest sessions of that user, leaving no more than max (ordering by the id of the sessions table). Create five sessions in a row with max = 3 and print how many remain and which of the five tokens are still valid (in order of creation). The labels are printed in Russian, exactly as shown.

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«осталось: 3»
«[false, false, true, true, true]»
«чужая сессия цела: true»
tasks.hint: After the insert: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = $1 AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM sessions WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT $2).

tasks.title: The AdminUser extractor
tasks.statement:
The CurrentUser extractor is ready. Write AdminUser(CurrentUser): FromRequestParts, which first obtains CurrentUser (its rejection is propagated), then checks role == "admin" and otherwise responds (StatusCode::FORBIDDEN, «нужны права администратора»). The handler GET /admin responds «админ NAME». Check: an administrator (vera), a regular user (anna), no token. The texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output:
(200, "админ vera")
(403, "нужны права администратора")
(401, "нужен токен")
tasks.hint: CurrentUser::from_request_parts(parts, state).await? then the role check.

tasks.title: Only the owner changes the topic
tasks.statement:
The CurrentUser extractor is ready. Write the handler PUT /rooms/{id}/topic/{text}: update the topic with one query that has the owner condition (UPDATE rooms SET topic = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND owner_id = $3). If 1 row is affected, respond 204. If 0, tell the cases apart: the room does not exist (404 «нет комнаты») or it belongs to someone else (403 «только владелец»). Check: the owner (anna), a non-owner (boris), an unknown room, no token, and then read the topic from the database. The texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output (the last line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
(403, "только владелец")
204
(404, "нет комнаты")
401
«тема: привет»
tasks.hint: Path((id, text)): Path<(i64, String)>; rows_affected(); on 0 — SELECT 1 FROM rooms WHERE id = $1.

tasks.title: Changing the password and revoking other sessions
tasks.statement:
The CurrentUser extractor (with the token_hash field) is ready. Write POST /password with JSON {"old":..,"new":..}: check the old password (check_pw against the hash from the database), otherwise 403 «неверный старый пароль»; a new password shorter than 8 characters gives 422; on success, in a transaction update the hash and delete all OTHER sessions of the user (token_hash <> the current one), and respond 204. Check: a wrong old password, a short new one, success; then that the second session is revoked, the current one is alive, and logging in with the old password is impossible (check_pw). The labels are printed in Russian, exactly as shown.

Expected output (lines with Russian text are shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
403
422
204
«текущая жива: 200»
«вторая отозвана: 401»
false true
tasks.hint: UPDATE users SET pass_hash = $1 WHERE id = $2; DELETE FROM sessions WHERE user_id = $2 AND token_hash <> $3; all in one transaction.

tasks.title: Forgot password: do not reveal existence
tasks.statement:
POST /forgot accepts {"name":..}. For ANY name (whether such a user exists or not) the response is the same: 202 and «если пользователь существует, мы отправили письмо». For an existing user, a row with kind = 'reset' is also added to the table outbox(user_id BIGINT, kind TEXT). Check: the responses for anna and an unknown name match byte for byte, and the outbox has exactly one row. The texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output (lines with Russian text are shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
202 202
«совпадают: true»
«если пользователь существует, мы отправили письмо»
«писем в очереди: 1»
tasks.hint: Do the insert only if the user is found, but build the response before it / independently of its result.

tasks.title: An authorization layer with Extension
tasks.statement:
Write a layer on from_fn_with_state(pool, auth) that extracts the token (bearer(&HeaderMap) is ready), finds the user by the token hash and a live session (SELECT s.user_id ...) and puts UserId(i64) into the request extensions; otherwise it responds 401 and JSON {"error":{"code":"unauthorized"}} without calling the handler. Attach the layer only to GET /api/me (route_layer); the handler responds «id: N». GET /health stays open. Check a token, no token, and /health without a token.

Expected output:
(200, "id: 2")
(401, "{\"error\":{\"code\":\"unauthorized\"}}")
401
(200, "ok")
tasks.hint: req.extensions_mut().insert(UserId(id)); route_layer only affects routes added before it.

tasks.title: A WebSocket token in the URL
tasks.statement:
A browser does not let you set a header when connecting over a WebSocket, so the token is passed as the parameter ?token=. Write the handler GET /ws (without a real upgrade for now): the token parameter from the query string (Query<WsQuery> with Option<String>) → if the session is alive, 200 and «ws: NAME», otherwise 401 and «нужен токен». Check: a correct token, a wrong one, no parameter. The texts are Russian, exactly as in «».

Expected output:
(200, "ws: boris")
(401, "нужен токен")
(401, "нужен токен")
tasks.hint: query_scalar over a JOIN of sessions/users with expires_at > now(); Option<String> in Query.

tasks.title: Cleaning up expired sessions
tasks.statement:
Write cleanup_expired(&PgPool) -> u64: it deletes all sessions whose expiry is in the past and returns their number. main creates two live and three expired sessions (expiries +1 hour and −1 second, directly through INSERT), calls the cleanup, and prints the number deleted and the remainder; a repeated call deletes 0. The labels are printed in Russian, exactly as shown.

Expected output (each line is shown in «», the quotes themselves are not printed):
«удалено: 3»
«осталось: 2»
«повторно: 0»
tasks.hint: DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expires_at <= now(); rows_affected().
